title.en: Suspect killed after opening fire on Secret Service near White House
title.zh: 白宫附近嫌疑人向特勤局人员开枪后被击毙

summary.en: Officials say a suspect approached a checkpoint near the building and opened fire, and that a bystander was wounded.
summary.zh: 官员称，一名嫌疑人靠近白宫附近的一个检查站并开枪，一名旁观者受伤。

body.en:
A suspect who shot at a White House checkpoint was killed in an exchange of fire with Secret Service agents on Saturday evening, officials have confirmed.

The BBC's US media partner CBS has named the suspect as Nasire Best, a 21-year-old man who was known to the protection agency and had a documented history of mental health conditions.

US President Donald Trump thanked the officers for their "swift and professional action" in apprehending the gunman, who he said in a Truth social post had a "violent history and possible obsession with our Country's most cherished structure".

The shooting comes only a month after a gunman opened fire at the White House Correspondents' Dinner.

The incident on Saturday remains under investigation and road closures around the White House will likely stay in place overnight.

Shortly before 18:00 local time (23:00 GMT), a man pulled a gun from his bag and "began firing" outside the White House at the intersection of 17th Street and Pennsylvania Avenue NW in Washington DC, near the Eisenhower Executive Office Building.

Secret Service officers posted on the corner returned fire, striking the gunman. He was then taken to hospital, where he was pronounced dead.

A bystander was also wounded in the shooting, but the Secret Service did not give further details on their condition. No officers were injured in the attack.

Trump was at the White House at the time, but "no protectees or operations were impacted", the agency said.

The suspect was later identified in US media as Best, who had been known to both the Secret Service and the Metropolitan Police Department and had used a revolver, law enforcement sources told CBS.

A source familiar with the investigation told CBS that Best had attempted to gain entry to the White House in July 2025 and had been arrested by officers nearby, after which he spent time at a psychiatric facility. He had been living in Washington DC for 18 months.

"Thank you to our great Secret Service and Law Enforcement for the swift and professional action taken this evening against a gunman near the White House," Trump wrote on social media.

Noting that the shooting had occurred since the White House Correspondents' Dinner was disrupted by a different shooter, he said it showed how important it was "for all future Presidents, to get, what will be, the most safe and secure space of its kind ever built in Washington" - a reference to his planned White House ballroom .

After shots were heard, reporters at the White House were rushed into a briefing room. Some had been filming when the incident occurred and shots could be heard in the distance as they spoke to camera.

Footage shared by the ABC's senior White House correspondent Selina Wang showed her taking cover as a volley of shots could be heard...
body.zh: 官员证实，周六晚上，一名在白宫检查站开枪的嫌疑人在与特勤局特工的交火中身亡。 BBC 的美国媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 已将嫌疑人命名为纳西尔·贝斯特 (Nasire Best)，他是一名 21 岁男子，保护机构认识他，并有精神健康问题记录。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普感谢警察在逮捕枪手方面采取了“迅速和专业的行动”，他在《真相》社交帖子中表示，枪手有“暴力历史，可能对我们国家最珍贵的建筑有痴迷”。 枪击事件发生仅一个月前，一名枪手在白宫记者晚宴上开枪。 周六的事件仍在调查中，白宫周围的道路可能会持续过夜。 当地时间18:00（格林威治标准时间23:00）前不久，一名男子从包里掏出一把枪，在华盛顿特区第17街和宾夕法尼亚大道西北路口、靠近艾森豪威尔行政办公大楼的白宫外“开枪”。 守在街角的特勤人员还击，击中了枪手。随后他被送往医院，并被宣布死亡。 一名旁观者也在枪击中受伤，但特勤局没有透露有关他们状况的更多细节。袭击中没有警员受伤。 该机构表示，特朗普当时正在白宫，但“没有受保护者或行动受到影响”。 执法消息人士告诉哥伦比亚广播公司，美国媒体后来确认嫌疑人为贝斯特，特勤局和大都会警察局都认识他，并使用了左轮手枪。 一位熟悉调查情况的消息人士告诉哥伦比亚广播公司，贝斯特曾于 2025 年 7 月试图进入白宫，但被附近的警察逮捕，之后他在一家精神病院住了一段时间。他已在华盛顿特区生活了 18 个月。 特朗普在社交媒体上写道：“感谢我们伟大的特勤局和执法部门今晚对白宫附近的一名枪手采取了迅速而专业的行动。” 他指出，枪击事件是在白宫记者晚宴被另一名枪手扰乱后发生的，他表示，这表明“对于所有未来的总统来说，获得华盛顿有史以来最安全的同类空间”是多么重要——指的是他计划中的白宫宴会厅。 听到枪声后，白宫记者被冲进新闻发布室。事件发生时，一些人正在拍摄，当他们对着镜头讲话时，可以听到远处的枪声。 美国广播公司 (ABC) 白宫高级记者塞琳娜·王 (Selina Wang) 分享的视频显示，她在听到一连串枪声时进行了掩护……

reflection.en: This story tragically illustrates the destructive nature of violence. When an individual resorts to force, it often leads to further harm, not only to others but also to themselves. This incident reminds us of the profound truth that violence begets violence, leaving a trail of injury and loss.
reflection.zh: 这个故事悲剧性地展现了暴力的毁灭性本质。当一个人诉诸武力时，往往会带来进一步的伤害，不仅是对他人，也是对自己。这起事件提醒我们一个深刻的真理：暴力滋生暴力，留下了伤害和损失的痕迹。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: ‘AI washing’: firms are scrambling to rebrand themselves as tech-focused
title.zh: “AI洗白”：公司争相将自己重塑为科技型企业

summary.en: PR executives say UK companies are forcing them to present ordinary automation as artificial intelligence UK companies are performing “yoga-level” stretches to describe themselves as AI specialists in an attempt to capitalise on the buzz around the technology, public relations...
summary.zh: 公关公司高管表示，英国企业正强迫他们将普通自动化技术包装成人工智能。公关界人士称，英国公司正竭尽全力将自己描述为人工智能专家，以期利用这项技术的热潮。

body.en: PR executives say UK companies are forcing them to present ordinary automation as artificial intelligence UK companies are performing “yoga-level” stretches to describe themselves as AI specialists in an attempt to capitalise on the buzz around the technology, public relations firms have said. Weary communications executives tasked with securing media coverage for brands have complained that bosses in low-tech industries or running businesses that use automation but not generative AI, are increasingly demanding they are pitched to journalists as artificial intelligence companies. Continue reading...
body.zh: 公关公司表示，公关高管表示，英国公司正迫使他们展示普通的自动化技术，就像人工智能一样。英国公司正在进行“瑜伽级别”的伸展运动，将自己描述为人工智能专家，试图利用围绕该技术的热潮。负责确保品牌媒体报道的疲惫的传播高管抱怨说，低技术行业的老板或经营使用自动化但不使用生成人工智能的企业的老板越来越要求他们向记者推销人工智能公司。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rush to rebrand ordinary automation as "AI" highlights a temptation to misrepresent for perceived advantage. Proverbs reminds us that integrity in commerce, like using honest weights and measures, is valued far above deceptive practices. True innovation and lasting trust are built on transparency, not on superficial "washing."
reflection.zh: 将普通自动化技术“洗白”成人工智能的潮流，凸显了为追求表面优势而进行虚假宣传的诱惑。箴言提醒我们，商业上的诚信，如同使用公正的砝码和度量，远比欺骗性的做法更受雅伟珍视。真正的创新和持久的信任是建立在透明基础上的，而非肤浅的“洗白”。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: £600 for cheese? The Brazilian beach scams that cost visitors dear
title.zh: 600英镑买奶酪？巴西海滩诈骗让游客损失惨重

summary.en: Travellers in Rio de Janeiro have reported being victims of debit card scams by beach vendors, with one tourist charged £1,500 for a kebab and another £3,000 for corn on the cob. One individual expected to pay 40 reais for cheese but was charged £600.
summary.zh: 据报道，里约热内卢的游客成为海滩小贩借记卡诈骗的受害者，一名游客被收取1,500英镑购买烤肉串，另一名游客被收取3,000英镑购买玉米。其中一人原以为只需支付40雷亚尔购买奶酪，结果却被收取了600英镑。

body.en: Travellers warned to beware of debit card cons after one was charged £1,500 for a kebab and another £3,000 for corn on the cob When Lisa Selby* used her debit card to pay for two slices of barbecued cheese from a beach vendor in Rio de Janeiro, she expected to pay 40 reais (£5.90) for the snack. But shortly after the payment had gone through, she realised that she had been charged 4,000 reais (£590) after the vendor added two extra zeros to the card reader. Continue reading...
body.zh: 旅客们被警告要小心借记卡的弊端，此前有人被收取了 1,500 英镑的烤肉串费用和另外 3,000 英镑的玉米棒子费用。当丽莎·塞尔比*用她的借记卡从里约热内卢海滩小贩那里购买两片烤奶酪时，她预计要支付 40 雷亚尔（5.90 英镑）的小吃。但付款完成后不久，她发现供应商在读卡器上多加了两个零，她被收取了 4,000 雷亚尔（590 英镑）的费用。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights how the love of money can lead to deceptive practices, causing significant distress and financial loss to unsuspecting individuals. Such scams remind us of the warning that the pursuit of wealth can lead people astray and inflict much sorrow.
reflection.zh: 这个故事揭示了贪爱钱财如何导致欺诈行为，给毫无戒心的个人带来巨大的困扰和经济损失。这样的骗局提醒我们，对财富的追求可能使人误入歧途，并带来许多愁苦。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Hunger increasingly used as weapon of war as ‘food-related violence’ surges, analysis shows
title.zh: 分析显示，饥饿日益被用作战争武器，“与食物相关的暴力”激增

summary.en: A new analysis reveals over 20,000 documented incidents of "food-related violence" since 2018, indicating that hunger is increasingly being exploited as a weapon of war. These attacks target markets, farmland, and food distribution systems.
summary.zh: 一项新分析显示，自2018年以来，已记录了超过2万起“与食物相关的暴力”事件，表明饥饿正日益被用作战争武器。这些袭击的目标包括市场、农田和食物分配系统。

body.en: More than 20,000 attacks on markets, farmland and food distribution systems have been recorded since 2018 Hunger is being increasingly exploited as a weapon of war with more than 20,000 documented incidents of “food-related violence” in the past eight years, new analysis reveals. Attacks include 1,261 strikes on markets used by families for daily groceries and 863 incidents in which food distribution systems were targeted and workers killed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自 2018 年以来，已记录了超过 20,000 起针对市场、农田和食品分配系统的袭击。新的分析显示，过去八年中，记录在案的“与食品相关的暴力”事件已超过 20,000 起，饥饿正越来越多地被用作战争武器。袭击事件包括 1,261 起针对家庭购买日常杂货的市场的袭击事件，以及 863 起食品分配系统成为袭击目标并造成工人死亡的事件。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The deliberate use of hunger as a weapon of war highlights a profound moral failure, turning basic sustenance into a tool of conflict. Isaiah 58:7 reminds us that true devotion involves sharing our food with the hungry and providing for the poor. This ancient call to compassion stands in stark contrast to the calculated cruelty of weaponizing food.
reflection.zh: 蓄意将饥饿用作战争武器，凸显了深刻的道德沦丧，将基本生存所需变成了冲突的工具。以赛亚书58:7提醒我们，真正的虔诚包括与饥饿的人分享食物，并供养贫困者。这种古老的怜悯呼唤，与蓄意将食物武器化的残忍行为形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Middle East crisis live: Pakistan hopes to host US-Iran peace talks ‘very soon’, says PM, after Trump claims Tehran deal ‘largely negotiated’
title.zh: 中东危机：霍尔木兹海峡命运悬而未决，特朗普称伊朗协议“已基本谈妥”

summary.en: The US president has stated that a deal with Iran, which includes opening the Strait of Hormuz, is largely negotiated. However, Iran's Fars news agency reports that the vital waterway would remain under Iranian control, indicating ongoing disagreement.
summary.zh: 美国总统表示，与伊朗达成的一项协议（其中包括开放霍尔木兹海峡）已基本谈妥。然而，伊朗法尔斯通讯社报道称，这条重要的水道将继续由伊朗控制，表明双方仍存在分歧。

The Directorate General of Civil Defence said the building had collapsed and a large number of vehicles and equipment had been damaged by a “direct hit in a hostile Israeli strike”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国总统表示，海峡将作为协议的一部分开放，但伊朗颇具影响力的法尔斯通讯社报道称，重要的水道仍将由伊朗控制。 完整报道：特朗普表示，与伊朗的和平协议“很大程度上是通过谈判”与霍尔木兹海峡开放的。特朗普的社交媒体帖子没有提及伊朗的核计划和高浓缩铀，德黑兰后来寻求就这些问题进行谈判，但官员们对结束战争的潜在协议越来越乐观。周六早些时候，一位直接了解巴基斯坦主导的调解工作的地区官员表示，美国和伊朗即将达成协议。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Diplomatic efforts to resolve international tensions often involve complex negotiations where peace hangs in the balance. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the constant call to pursue peace, "If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone." Even when agreements are "largely negotiated," the path to lasting peace requires persistent...
reflection.zh: 解决国际紧张局势的外交努力常常涉及复杂的谈判，和平的命运悬而未决。罗马书12:18提醒我们，要不断地追求和平，“若是可能，总要尽力与众人和睦。”即使协议“基本谈妥”，通往持久和平的道路仍需要各方持续的努力和寻求共同点的承诺。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: 'I shouted run': Witness recalls moment of China's worst mine disaster in years
title.zh: “我大喊快跑”：目击者回忆中国多年来最严重的矿难时刻

summary.en: The incident is China's deadliest mining accident since 2009, when a gas explosion at the Xinxing mine in Heilongjiang province killed 108 people.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As emergency rescuers undertook a major rescue operation after Saturday's mining accident that killed at least 82 people in northern China, a wounded survivor said he heard no sound but smelled sulphur when the explosion happened.

"I didn't hear any sound at all, but then a cloud of smoke appeared," miner Wang Yong said.

"When I smelled it, it was the smell of sulphur like when people set off firecrackers. When the smoke came down, I shouted for people to run," he said.

"After more than an hour, I came to on my own, and then I woke up the person next to me" and got out, he told Chinese broadcaster CCTV.

The blast at the Liushenyu shaft in Shanxi province was the country's worst mining disaster in nearly two decades, with 247 workers underground at the time, according to Chinese media.

Hundreds of rescuers have rushed to the site, with medical teams taking 128 people to the hospital as of Saturday evening (local time), loaded into ambulances and carried on stretchers. Two people still remain missing.

Agence France-Presse journalists saw police blocking the road leading to the mine late Saturday, allowing only authorised vehicles to enter.

Helmeted rescuers took turns descending into the shaft overnight to look for the two missing workers, state media reported.

"As long as there is hope, we will make every possible effort," one rescuer told Xinhua news agency.

Chinese authorities launched an investigation into the blast, the worst since 2009 when 108 people were killed in a mine explosion in northeastern Heilongjiang province.

Preliminary findings showed the company operating the mine had committed "serious illegal violations", authorities told a press conference.

"Those found responsible will be severely punished in accordance with laws and regulations," they added.

A person "responsible for" the company involved had been "placed under control in accordance with the law", Xinhua reported.

The State Council, China's cabinet, ordered nationwide "tough crackdowns on illegal and unlawful activities", including the falsification of safety data, unclear headcounts of underground workers and illegal contracting.

Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, is the centre of the country's coal-mining industry.

Mine safety in China has improved in recent decades, but accidents still occur in an industry where safety protocols are often lax and regulations are vague.

In 2023, a collapse at an open-pit coal mine in the northern Inner Mongolia region killed 53 people.

China is the world's top consumer of coal and the largest greenhouse gas emitter, despite installing renewable energy capacity at record speed.

Coal miners in the sleepy Chinese county of Qinyuan sometimes dine at Zhang's skewer eatery, especially on payday, and the accident has left...
body.zh: 周六，中国北方发生了导致至少 82 人死亡的矿难，紧急救援人员在开展重大救援行动时，一名受伤的幸存者表示，爆炸发生时他没有听到任何声音，但闻到了硫磺的味道。 “我根本没有听到任何声音，但随后出现了一团烟雾。”矿工王勇说。 “当我闻到的时候，那是硫磺的味道，就像人们放鞭炮时一样。当烟雾降下时，我大声喊叫人们快跑，”他说。 他告诉中国中央电视台，“一个多小时后，我自己醒了过来，然后我叫醒了旁边的人”，然后下了车。 据中国媒体报道，山西省六神峪竖井爆炸是该国近二十年来最严重的矿难，当时井下有 247 名工人。 截至周六晚间（当地时间），数百名救援人员已赶赴现场，医疗队已将 128 人送往医院，并装上救护车并用担架抬上。目前仍有两人失踪。 法新社记者周六晚看到警察封锁了通往矿井的道路，只允许经过授权的车辆进入。 据官方媒体报道，戴着头盔的救援人员连夜轮流进入竖井寻找两名失踪的工人。 “只要有希望，我们就会尽一切努力，”一名救援人员告诉新华社。 中国当局对这起爆炸展开调查，这是自2009年黑龙江省东北部矿井爆炸造成108人死亡以来最严重的一次。 当局在新闻发布会上表示，初步调查结果显示，该矿运营公司存在“严重违法行为”。 他们补充说：“对相关责任人，将依法依规予以严厉处罚。” 据新华社报道，涉事公司一名“负责人”已被“依法控制”。 中国国务院下令在全国范围内“严厉打击违法违规行为”，包括伪造安全数据、井下工人人数不明和非法承包等。 山西是中国较贫困的省份之一，也是全国煤炭开采业的中心。 近几十年来，中国的矿山安全有所改善，但安全规程往往松懈、法规模糊的行业中事故仍然时有发生。 2023年，内蒙古北部地区一座露天煤矿发生塌方，造成53人死亡。 尽管中国以创纪录的速度安装可再生能源产能，但它仍然是世界上最大的煤炭消费国和最大的温室气体排放国。 在中国寂静的沁源县，煤矿工人有时会在张的烤串店吃饭，尤其是在发薪日，事故已经发生……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: 'He thrives on controversy': The past and possible future of Israel's 'TikTok minister'
title.zh: “他在争议中茁壮成长”：以色列“TikTok部长”的过去和可能的未来

summary.en: Itamar Ben-Gvir has risen to the highest level of Israeli politics, but he may not have a long future there.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Far-right Israeli national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir was once again in the headlines this week after a video of him taunting detained activists went viral , drawing rebuke from world leaders and his own prime minister.

However, it arguably isn't the most notorious footage featuring the man some Israelis refer to as the 'TikTok minister'.

In November 1995, just weeks before then Israeli prime minister Yitzak Rabin was assassinated by an ultranationalist Jew opposed to peace talks with Palestinians, a teenage Ben-Gvir appeared on live television holding an emblem stolen from the prime minister's Cadillac and saying: "We got to his car, and we'll get to him, too."

Ben-Gvir has never been accused of any direct responsibility for Rabin's death. But he and the extremist who did kill him moved in broadly similar ideological circles, fiercely against the Oslo Accords that Rabin signed.

The two incidents are also only the bookends of a prolific array of provocative videos the 50-year-old has become known for over the years.

In August last year, he posted videos of himself taunting popular Palestinian prisoner Marwan Barghouti in his jail cell. Several months later, footage emerged of him mocking a previous group of captured Global Sumud Flotilla activists and accusing them of supporting terrorism.

Ran Porat from The Australian Centre for Jewish Civilisation at Monash University described Ben-Gvir as someone who "operates by creating these viral moments of 'this is Jewish power'."

"He thrives on controversy ... He thrives on these videos that depict him as powerful," said Porat, who is also a research associate for the Australia/Israel & Jewish Affairs Council.

However, Porat and other experts don't think Ben-Gvir is likely to remain in government after the upcoming Israeli elections, even if he might be increasingly popular among the nation's hard-right edge.

Ben-Gvir's televised 1995 threat to the prime minister took place when he was a member of a right-wing youth movement opposing the mid-1990s peace negotiations between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization.

In his younger years, he faced dozens of charges relating to anti-Arab incitement, support of proscribed organisations, disturbing the peace and other public-order offences, but was acquitted of most. He has eight criminal convictions, including support for a terrorist organisation and incitement to racism, one of which related to him carrying a sign reading "Expel the Arab enemy" in 2007.

He is a long-time settler in the occupied West Bank and, while working as a defence attorney before entering parliament, represented many Jewish settlers accused of violence against Palestinians.

Although he has been active in Israeli parliamentary politics...
body.zh: 以色列极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔本周再次成为头条新闻，此前他嘲笑被拘留的活动人士的视频在网上疯传，引起了世界领导人和他自己的总理的谴责。 然而，这可能不是一些以色列人称之为“TikTok 部长”的最臭名昭著的视频。 1995 年 11 月，就在时任以色列总理伊扎克·拉宾 (Yitzak Rabin) 被一名反对与巴勒斯坦人和谈的极端民族主义犹太人暗杀的几周前，十几岁的本·格维尔 (Ben-Gvir) 出现在电视直播中，手里拿着从总理的凯迪拉克上偷来的徽章，并说道：“我们上了他的车，我们也会找到他。” 本-格维尔从未被指控对拉宾之死负有任何直接责任。但他和杀害他的极端分子在大致相似的意识形态圈子里活动，强烈反对拉宾签署的《奥斯陆协议》。 这两起事件也只是这位 50 岁的人多年来出名的一系列大量挑衅性视频的书挡。 去年八月，他发布了自己在牢房中嘲笑受欢迎的巴勒斯坦囚犯马尔万·巴尔古提的视频。几个月后，视频出现，显示他嘲笑先前被俘的全球苏姆德船队活动分子，并指责他们支持恐怖主义。 莫纳什大学澳大利亚犹太文明中心的兰·波拉特 (Ran Porat) 将本·格维尔描述为“通过创造‘这是犹太力量’的病毒式时刻来运作的人”。 “他在争议中茁壮成长……他在这些描绘他强大的视频中茁壮成长，”波拉特说，他也是澳大利亚/以色列和犹太事务委员会的研究员。 然而，波拉特和其他专家认为，本-格维尔在即将到来的以色列选举后不太可能继续留在政府，即使他可能在该国的极右翼边缘中越来越受欢迎。 1995 年，本-格维尔在电视上对总理发出威胁，当时他是反对 90 年代中期以色列与巴勒斯坦解放组织之间和平谈判的右翼青年运动的成员。 在他年轻的时候，他面临数十项与反阿拉伯煽动、支持被禁组织、扰乱和平和其他公共秩序犯罪有关的指控，但大多数罪名被无罪释放。 他有八项刑事定罪，包括支持恐怖组织和煽动种族主义，其中一项与他在 2007 年举着“驱逐阿拉伯敌人”的牌子有关。 他是被占领的约旦河西岸的长期定居者，在进入议会之前担任辩护律师，曾代表许多被指控对巴勒斯坦人实施暴力的犹太定居者。 尽管他一直活跃于以色列议会政治......

reflection.en: This story draws attention to hope, endurance, and faithful rebuilding. Romans 12:12 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with steady hope and perseverance, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到盼望、忍耐与重建。Romans 12:12提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以坚定盼望与忍耐来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: One dead, multiple injured after Russia launches wave of strikes on Ukraine
title.zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰发动一波袭击造成一人死亡多人受伤

summary.en: Twenty-one people have been injured, including a 15-year-old boy, with damage reported across all districts of Kyiv.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One person has been killed and 21 others injured after Russia launched a large wave of missile and drones strikes on the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv.

Explosions were heard across the city, with mayor Vitali ⁠Klitschko writing on Telegram that damage has been reported in all districts, including residential buildings and school.

A 15-year-old boy was among those injured and 13 people have been taken to hospital, three of them in "a serious condition", Klitschko said.

The strikes come following Russian President Vladimir Putin's vow to retaliate after accusing Ukraine of carrying out a deadly attack on a student dormitory in the town of Starobilsk on Friday, where 18 people were killed.

In a statement, the General Staff of Ukraine's Armed Forces said it did carry out an attack near Starobilsk in Russian-occupied eastern Ukraine overnight on Friday, but maintains that it struck a Russian military unit.

Russia's overnight strike on Sunday hit more than 40 locations across Kyiv, with falling debris sparking fires at residential buildings, warehouses, a supermarket and shopping centre, according to Klitschko.

"The capital has been subjected to a massive ballistic attack. Further launches are possible," Tymur Tkachenko, head of the Kyiv's military administration wrote on Telegram shortly after midnight.

One person was killed after a nine-story residential building in the central district of Shevchenko was hit and a fire broke out on the top floors.

The same district, a strike near an air raid shelter at a school blocked its entrance with debris, trapping several people inside.

Emergency services rushed to multiple scenes of damage across the city, putting out blazes, clearing debris and treating the injured.

"The cleanup of the aftermath of the shelling is ongoing," Tkachenko said, adding that the deployment of aid headquarters will be announced soon.

On Saturday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that there were signs that Russia was preparing for "a combined strike on Ukrainian territory, including Kyiv.

He cited intelligence from Ukraine, Europe and the US that signalled Russia could be preparing a strike with the Oreshnik missile, which reportedly travels more than 10 times the speed of light and is currently impossible to intercept.
body.zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰首都基辅发动大规模导弹和无人机袭击，造成 1 人死亡、21 人受伤。 整个城市都传来爆炸声，市长维塔利·克里琴科在 Telegram 上写道，所有地区都报告了损坏情况，包括住宅楼和学校。 克里琴科说，伤者中有一名 15 岁男孩，另有 13 人被送往医院，其中三人“伤势严重”。 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京指责乌克兰周五对斯塔罗比尔斯克镇的一所学生宿舍发动致命袭击，造成 18 人死亡，随后俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京发誓要进行报复。 乌克兰武装部队总参谋部在一份声明中表示，周五夜间确实在俄罗斯占领的乌克兰东部斯塔罗比尔斯克附近发动了袭击，但坚称袭击了俄罗斯军事单位。 克里琴科表示，俄罗斯周日的夜间罢工袭击了基辅全境 40 多个地点，掉落的碎片引发了住宅楼、仓库、一家超市和购物中心的火灾。 基辅军事管理局局长泰穆尔·特卡琴科（Tymur Tkachenko）在午夜过后不久在 Telegram 上写道：“首都遭受了大规模弹道攻击。可能会进一步发射。” 舍甫琴科中心区一栋九层住宅楼被击中，顶层起火，造成一人死亡。 在同一地区，一所学校防空洞附近发生的一次袭击用碎片堵住了入口，导致数人被困在里面。 紧急服务人员赶往全市多个受损现场，扑灭大火、清理废墟并治疗伤者。 特卡琴科说：“炮击后果的清理工作正在进行中。”他补充说，援助指挥部的部署将很快宣布。 周六，乌克兰总统泽连斯基警告称，有迹象表明俄罗斯正在准备“对包括基辅在内的乌克兰领土进行联合打击”。 他引用了来自乌克兰、欧洲和美国的情报，这些情报表明俄罗斯可能正在准备使用奥列什尼克导弹进行打击，据报道该导弹的飞行速度超过光速10倍以上，目前无法拦截。

title.en: It's like the Olympics - except steroids are allowed
title.zh: 这就像奥运会——只是允许使用兴奋剂

summary.en: The inaugural Enhanced Games, an event where performance-enhancing drugs are permitted, is set to launch this weekend in Las Vegas, drawing significant attention, high-profile participants, and considerable debate.
summary.zh: 首届“增强型运动会”将于本周末在拉斯维加斯举行，该赛事允许运动员使用兴奋剂，吸引了众多知名选手和巨额资金，但也引发了巨大争议。

body.en:
Under the blazing Vegas sun, giant billboards advertise "Live Enhanced" as the baritone voice of a sports announcer pretends to introduce British swimmer Ben Proud and other athletes.

The announcer is practicing at a new open air arena hosting one of the most controversial events in recent sporting history: the Enhanced Games.

The inaugural competition on Sunday will feature dozens of elite athletes using performance-enhancing drugs to try and break world records in track, weightlifting and swimming.

Some $25m (£18.6m) in prize money is up for grabs - with cash prizes for winners. World records in certain events, being eyed up by the likes of US sprinter Fred Kerley , pay a $1m (£740,000) bonus.

The drugs they use must be legal, and approved by the Federal Drug Administration. But substances like testosterone and human growth hormone - banned by the World Anti-Doping Agency - are not only celebrated here, they're encouraged and for sale.

The project was founded by entrepreneurs Aron D'Souza and Maximilian Martin in 2023 and has attracted backing from prominent investors including billionaire Peter Thiel and Donald Trump Jr.

Health experts warn that anabolic steroids and growth hormones can cause strokes and cardiovascular damage, among other risks.

Event organisers claim Enhanced will push the limits of human performance while critics, especially in the Olympic movement, dismiss it as an affront to the spirit and founding principles of competitive sport.

"You don't have to be pressured or use drugs in order to be the best," says Travis Tygart, CEO of the US Anti Doping Agency, USADA.

He tells the BBC that while there are clear failures with the Olympics' anti-doping protocols, the answer is reforming the system, not to dope.

Athletes, he says, need to be assured the Olympics are clean and cheats will not be tolerated.

"We don't want kids to have to say, 'in order to win an Olympic medal, when I'm 18 or 20 years old, I have to inject myself every day in the rear end with a potentially dangerous drug.'"

But Enhanced, the company behind the games, claims it is bringing out into the open what it says is an undercurrent of many athletes cheat and take performance-enhancing drugs in the shadows.

Packed into a ballroom at Resorts World casino, Enhanced athletes answered media questions for two hours, but only one - strongman Hafthor Bjornsson who hopes to break his own deadlift record of 510 kg (1,124.4 pounds) - would say which drugs he was taking. Other athletes were tight lipped.

Bjornsson, who played the Mountain in Game of Thrones, says he's open about his steroid use because it's accepted in the professional strongman world.

American sprinter Shania Collins says the fact that those taking part in the games admit to doping, already...
body.zh: 在拉斯维加斯炽热的阳光下，巨大的广告牌上打着“LiveEnhanced”的广告，体育播音员的男中音假装介绍英国游泳运动员本·普劳德和其他运动员。 播音员正在一个新的露天竞技场练习，这里正在举办近代体育史上最具争议的赛事之一：增强运动会。 周日的首届比赛将有数十名精英运动员使用提高成绩的药物来尝试打破田径、举重和游泳方面的世界纪录。 约 2500 万美元（1860 万英镑）的奖金可供争夺 - 获胜者可获得现金奖励。某些项目的世界纪录受到美国短跑运动员 Fred Kerley 等人的关注，并支付 100 万美元（74 万英镑）的奖金。 他们使用的药物必须是合法的，并经联邦药物管理局批准。但睾丸激素和人类生长激素等被世界反兴奋剂机构禁止的物质在这里不仅受到庆祝，而且受到鼓励和出售。 该项目由企业家 Aron D'Souza 和 Maximilian Martin 于 2023 年创立，并吸引了包括亿万富翁 Peter Thiel 和 Donald Trump Jr. 在内的知名投资者的支持。 健康专家警告说，合成代谢类固醇和生长激素可能导致中风和心血管损伤等风险。 赛事组织者声称“增强型”将挑战人类表现的极限，而批评者，尤其是奥林匹克运动中的批评者，则认为这是对竞技体育精神和基本原则的侮辱。 美国反兴奋剂机构 (USADA) 首席执行官特拉维斯·泰加特 (Travis Tygart) 表示：“你不必承受压力或使用药物才能成为最好的。” 他告诉英国广播公司，虽然奥运会的反兴奋剂协议存在明显的失败，但答案是改革制度，而不是使用兴奋剂。 他说，运动员需要放心，奥运会是干净的，作弊行为不会被容忍。 “我们不希望孩子们说，‘为了赢得奥运会奖牌，当我 18 或 20 岁的时候，我必须每天给自己注射一种有潜在危险的药物。’” 但赛事背后的Enhanced公司声称，它正在将许多运动员在暗中作弊和服用提高成绩的药物的暗流公之于众。 挤在名胜世界赌场的宴会厅里，Enhanced 运动员回答了媒体问题两个小时，但只有一位大力士哈夫索尔·比约恩森 (Hafthor Bjornsson) 说出了他正在服用哪种药物，他希望打破自己的 510 公斤（1,124.4 磅）硬拉纪录。其他运动员则守口如瓶。 在《权力的游戏》中扮演魔山的比约恩森表示，他对类固醇的使用持开放态度，因为这在职业强人世界中是被接受的。 美国短跑运动员仙妮亚·柯林斯表示，参加比赛的人已经承认服用兴奋剂……

reflection.en: The Enhanced Games, with their focus on pushing human limits through permitted enhancements, invite us to consider the nature of achievement and the prizes we pursue. While athletes strive for a perishable crown, the Christian life calls for discipline aimed at an imperishable one, reminding us that true victory lies beyond fleeting earthly glory.
reflection.zh: 增强型运动会通过允许增强剂来挑战人类极限，这促使我们思考成就的本质和我们所追求的奖赏。运动员们为那会朽坏的冠冕而努力，但基督徒的生命呼召我们为那不能朽坏的冠冕而自律，提醒我们真正的胜利超越了短暂的世俗荣耀。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Iranian football team moves FIFA World Cup base from United States to Mexico
title.zh: 伊朗足球队将世界杯基地从美国迁至墨西哥

summary.en: Iran's participation in the World Cup has been in question since February, when the United States and Israel began bombing the country.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Iran is moving its World Cup training base to Mexico after football's world governing body FIFA approved a request to transfer it from Tucson, Arizona, the head of Iran's football federation said overnight.

The Iranian team will now be based in Tijuana on the border of Mexico and the United States during the tournament, federation president Mehdi Taj said in a video carried by the Fars news agency.

"Fortunately, thanks to the meetings we had with FIFA officials ... our request to change countries from the United States to Mexico, due to problems encountered in obtaining visas, was accepted by FIFA," Taj said.

"We will therefore be based in Tijuana, near the Pacific Ocean. It is a city that lies between Mexico and the US, but it is located in Mexico. We have actually completed the team building there."

Taj said that the move would help to avoid complications related to visas and that the squad could use Iran Air flights to travel directly to Mexico.

Iran's participation in the World Cup has been in question for months because it is being co-hosted by the United States, which along with Israel began bombing Iran on 28 February, sparking a wider war in the Middle East.

Iran has been drawn in Group G and will play their first two matches in Los Angeles.

The team opens its campaign against New Zealand on 15 June and will then face Belgium on 21 June before rounding off their group games against Egypt in Seattle on 26 June.

Taj said that Tijuana was closer to the cities where Iran will play than the camp in Arizona would have been.

"The distance for us in the two games that we have in LA will be a 55-minute flight. Which is a lot less compared to Tucson," the federation president said.

The Iran team is currently preparing in Antalya, southern Türkiye, and some of the squad went to the US embassy in Ankara on Thursday (local time) to submit visa applications for the World Cup.

The Iranian football federation's vice-president Mehdi Mohammad Nabi said on Tuesday that the federation was unsure if US visas would be granted to all of the team and accompanying officials.

"We're not certain yet that all the players and staff will receive US visas," he said, but added that Iran was "very confident" in FIFA's protocols.

Sarah Hanna, the head of the Kino Sports Complex in Tucson where the Iran team were to have been based , told Agence France-Presse that she could not confirm the move to Mexico and referred all questions to World Cup organisers.

title.en: How three Red Cross volunteers became the first victims of the latest Ebola outbreak
title.zh: 三名红十字志愿者如何成为最新埃博拉疫情的第一批受害者

summary.en: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola was declared an emergency of international concern by the World Health Organization on Sunday.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The Red Cross announced overnight that three volunteers had died in the Democratic Republic of Congo after apparently contracting Ebola while on duty in March.

The central African country has been gripped by an outbreak of the deadly viral disease which the World Health Organization (WHO) has declared an international public health emergency .

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) said the volunteers were from the DR Congo Red Cross in the northeastern Ituri province.

They worked for the branch in Mongbwalu, considered the epicentre of the outbreak.

The three staffers, Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo and Ajiko Chandiru Viviane, are believed to have contracted Ebola while carrying out "dead body management activities" on 27 March as part of a humanitarian mission unrelated to Ebola, the IFRC said in a statement.

"At the time of the intervention, the community was not aware of the Ebola virus disease outbreak, and the outbreak had not yet been identified. They are among the first known victims of the outbreak."

"These volunteers lost their lives while serving their communities with courage and humanity," the Geneva-based federation said.

"Their commitment reflects the extraordinary dedication shown every day by Red Cross volunteers working in complex and high-risk environments."

Bodies of Ebola victims are highly infectious ‌after death, ⁠and unsafe burials — where family members handle the body without proper protective equipment — are a leading driver of transmission.

The IFRC, which has more than 17 million volunteers in more than 191 countries, is the world's largest humanitarian network.

It said it remained committed to supporting communities affected by Ebola and to strengthening efforts to respond to the outbreak.

There are 82 confirmed cases and seven confirmed deaths in the DR Congo, with almost 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, the WHO said on Friday.

The outbreak, which experts suspect was circulating under the radar for some time , is due to the less common Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments.

The IFRC has launched an emergency appeal for 29 million Swiss francs (A$51.7 million).

Gabriela Arenas, the IFRC's Africa regional operations coordinator, said that in Mongbwalu, volunteers were knocking on doors, advising communities on how to protect themselves.

"Community reactions remain mixed," she told reporters in Geneva on Friday, speaking from Nairobi.

"For some people, the outbreak is very real, and they are seeking information on how to protect themselves and their families. For others, there is still suspicion and misinformation with claims that Ebola is fabricated."

title.en: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
title.zh: 中国煤矿爆炸至少82人死亡

summary.en: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
At least 82 people have been killed and two are missing after a coal mine blast in northern China, officials have said.

Rescue officials revised down the death toll in an update late on Saturday, having earlier said at least 90 people had died.

The gas explosion at the Liushenyu Coal Mine in Shanxi province is the worst mining disaster in China since 2009.

There were 247 workers reportedly on duty when the blast happened at 19:29 local time (11:29 GMT) on Friday, with more than 100 people said to be saved and hundreds of rescuers sent to the site.

Chinese President Xi Jinping said no effort must be spared in efforts to treat the injured and search for survivors.

The country's state council later said a "rigorous" investigation would be conducted and those found responsible would be "severely punished".

Officials apologised for the confusion over the death toll, saying the situation was chaotic at the beginning which led to an unclear headcount and an incorrect figure.

They said that 128 people were being treated in hospitals, including two in critical condition.

Most were affected after inhaling poisonous gas, according to state media, though it is not clear what type of gas it was.

Early on Sunday morning, rescuers deployed mine inspection robots underground, equipped with gas sensors and infrared cameras, state media reported.

The robots were operated by rescue workers who used them to enter unreachable areas to collect data and detect signs of life.

Local officials have also ordered immediate safety inspections of coal mines across Shanxi province. Production has been suspended at all four mines run by the group in charge of the Liushenyu Coal Mine, state media reported.

Wang Yong, an injured miner, told state media that when the incident happened, he did not hear a sound but saw a sudden plume of smoke.

"I smelled sulphur, the same smell you get from blasting. I shouted at people to run. As we were running I could see people collapsing from the fumes. Then I blacked out too," he said.

"I lay there for about an hour or so before I came round on my own. I woke up the person next to me and we got out together."

Some of the management team at the mine have reportedly been detained. The cause of the gas explosion has not yet been revealed, but state media reported that the levels of carbon monoxide - a highly toxic, odourless gas - in the mine were found to have "exceeded limits".

China's Ministry of Emergency Management has sent 345 personnel from six rescue teams to help with the operation.

State media said the rescue operation had encountered difficulties as water has built up near the explosion site, preventing access to certain areas, while blueprints provided by the mine did not match the actual conditions.

title.en: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated' including reopening Strait of Hormuz
title.zh: 特朗普称伊朗与美国“越来越接近”达成协议

summary.en: Former US President Trump stated that Iran is nearing an agreement with the United States. Tehran also indicated progress in the talks, clarifying that the critical issue of nuclear weapons is not part of the initial framework being developed.
summary.zh: 美国前总统特朗普表示，伊朗正与美国“越来越接近”达成协议。德黑兰也表示谈判取得进展，但指出核武器这一关键问题不属于正在制定的初步框架。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump says an agreement with Iran has been "largely negotiated" and details will be announced soon.

The deal would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, he said on Saturday, without giving further details.

Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei earlier told state television that US and Iranian positions had been converging in the last week, but warned that did not mean agreements would be reached on key issues and accused the Americans of "contradictory statements".

On social media, Trump said he had a "very good call" with the leaders of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and others about a "Memorandum of Understanding pertaining to PEACE".

"An agreement has been largely negotiated, subject to finalization between the United States of America, the Islamic Republic of Iran, and the various other Countries, as listed," Trump said.

"Final aspects and details of the deal are currently being discussed, and will be announced shortly."

He also said he had a call on Saturday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, which "went very well".

The president has not given any further details on the deal, but has insisted any agreement would "absolutely" prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon.

Later, Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said: "I congratulate President Donald Trump on his extraordinary efforts to pursue peace," and said the phone call had been "very useful and productive".

Pakistan has been helping to negotiate a peace deal , serving as an intermediary.

"We hope to host the next round of talks very soon," he wrote in the statement on X.

The US and Israel launched wide-ranging strikes on Iran on 28 February, sparking conflict across the Middle East. Iran responded by launching attacks on Israel and US-allied states in the Gulf.

A ceasefire in Iran was agreed in early April, and since then Washington and Tehran have engaged in talks over a long-term peace deal.

Speaking to state television on Saturday, Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei also described a "memorandum of understanding", saying Iran's intention was to reach an agreement "in the form of a framework, consisting of 14 points".

Baqaei said they were in the process of finalising the memorandum, so further talks could be held within 30 to 60 days "and ultimately a final agreement can be reached".

The new sense of momentum comes after the mood appeared to have soured in Washington, with anonymous officials briefing US media on Friday that the administration was preparing for a fresh round of military strikes, although no final decision had been made.

title.zh: 塞尔维亚：警方与要求提前选举的抗议者发生冲突

summary.en: Tens of thousands of protesters in Serbia clashed with police while demonstrating against President Aleksandar Vucic's government and demanding early elections. Officers used teargas and stun grenades, and the state rail operator canceled trains to Belgrade in an attempt to hinder the rally.
summary.zh: 数万名抗议者在塞尔维亚与警方发生冲突，反对亚历山大·武契奇总统的政府并要求提前举行选举。警方使用了催泪瓦斯和眩晕手榴弹，国家铁路运营商取消了往返贝尔格莱德的列车，试图阻止集会。

body.en:
Officers fired teargas and stun grenades as tens of thousands rallied against President Aleksandar Vucic's government. The demonstration went ahead despite the state rail operator canceling trains to and from Belgrade.

Clashes broke out between groups of demonstrators and police as a student-led movement returned to Serbia's capital Belgrade on Saturday, demanding an end to President Aleksandar Vucic's 12-year rule.

The populist leader has been accused by critics of consolidating power and undermining democratic checks and balances.

The protest movement erupted some 18 months ago after 16 people were killed when a newly-renovated roof collapsed at a major railway station , blamed on corruption and negligence.

According to media reports, tens of thousands of people joined the rally, with many protesters wearing T-shirts with the slogan "Students win" or carrying Serbian flags or banners bearing the names of their town or city.

While the main protest was mostly peaceful, groups of young demonstrators later split and clashed with police, throwing flares, rocks and bottles. Riot police responded with tear gas and stun grenades as they charged forward to disperse them.

During the protest, participants called for early parliamentary elections, accused the government of crime and corruption and demanded the return of the rule of law.

After trains were canceled in and out of Belgrade , citing a bomb scare, organizers also accused the state rail operator of trying to prevent people from other parts of Serbia from traveling to the protest.

The rally, in Belgrade's Slavija Square, was the scene of a huge anti-government protest in March 2025 that drew 300,000 people before ending in controversial circumstances.

During that rally, the government denied using a sonic weapon against the protesters, a denial that independent experts could not fully confirm.

The student movement emerged after the deadly collapse of a 48-meter concrete canopy at a railway station in Serbia's second-largest city, Novi Sad, in November 2024.

The collapse was blamed on poor workmanship and inadequate oversight, sparking a huge public outcry.

In the aftermath, then-Prime Minister Milos Vucevic was forced to resign, while Vucic launched a crackdown on the protest movement after some of the rallies turned violent.

While Saturday's rally unfolded, Vucic’s loyalists gathered in a park camp outside the Serbian presidency building that he set up last March as a human shield against protesters.

Vucic and pro-government media outlets have recently ramped up political rhetoric against his critics, labeling them as terrorists and foreign agents who wish to destroy the country.

title.en: Cyprus election expected to shake up national politics
title.zh: 塞浦路斯选举预计将撼动国家政治

summary.en: Cyprus is holding parliamentary elections on Sunday, with expectations that the vote will significantly alter the national political scene, weakening established parties and boosting new anti-establishment groups.
summary.zh: 塞浦路斯将于周日举行议会选举。预计此次投票将重塑该国的政治格局，削弱传统政党，并加速新兴反建制运动的崛起。

body.en:
Cyprus goes to the polls to elect a new parliament on Sunday. The vote is expected to reshape the country's political landscape, weaken traditional parties and accelerate the rise of new anti-establishment movements.

Voters in Cyprus  head to the polls Sunday for what is shaping up to be one of the country's most significant parliamentary elections in decades.

Although the parliament holds limited powers within the presidential system of the Republic of Cyprus, the outcome of the election is expected to transform the country's political landscape.

Citing recent opinion polls, journalist and political analyst Sotiris Paroutis said  Cyprus is heading toward "a profound transformation of its political scene," characterized by the weakening of the country's two dominant parties and by the collapse of traditional centrist forces. Meanwhile, new political forces are gaining support.

Polls suggest the race for first place will once again be decided between Cyprus' two traditional political heavyweights: the conservative Democratic Rally (DISY) and the left-wing Progressive Party of Working People (AKEL).

For DISY, the election will be a major test of political resilience following the loss of the presidency and the internal tensions that followed the election of independent candidate and former DISY member Nikos Christodoulides as president in 2023 .

AKEL, meanwhile, hopes to win the general election for the first time since 2006 by capitalizing on the political momentum it has built in recent years.

But even if the two major parties remain dominant, opinion polls indicate they are unlikely to repeat the high vote shares they obtained in recent decades.

Corruption scandals, growing public frustration and declining trust in the political establishment appear to be steadily eroding Cyprus' long-standing bipartisan model.

In Cyprus , the president, who is elected directly by the people, is both head of state and head of government and appoints the cabinet ministers. This means that while the parliamentary election has no direct influence on the makeup of the government, it will have a bearing on the alliances that the parties will have to form in the hope of getting their candidate elected in the next presidential election , which is scheduled for 2028.

According to opinion polls, the far-right National Popular Front (ELAM) is expected to emerge as the country's third-largest political force, securing around 10% of the vote.

The party first entered parliament in 2016 at a time when it was widely viewed as politically aligned with Greece's now-defunct neo-Nazi Golden Dawn party.

When a nation lacks a guiding vision, people may feel adrift and seek new paths. This election highlights the ongoing need for leaders who can offer wise instruction and a hopeful future.

title.en: US, Iran strike upbeat tone as Hormuz deal takes shape
title.zh: 美国和伊朗就霍尔木兹协议达成乐观基调

summary.en: US President Donald Trump indicated progress in discussions with Iran regarding a potential deal in the Strait of Hormuz, though Tehran cautioned that significant obstacles remain before the conflict can be de-escalated.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，与伊朗就霍尔木兹海峡协议的谈判取得了进展，但德黑兰警告称，在冲突降级之前仍存在重大分歧。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump flagged progress in talks with Iran, Tehran has warned that major gaps still stand in the way of dialing down the conflict.

The United States and Iran  signaled progress on Saturday toward a framework agreement that could end a nearly three-month standoff triggered by US and Israeli attacks on Iran and the shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz .

The step forward comes as global pressure grows to avert a wider regional conflict, with mediators saying both sides are inching closer to a workable de-escalation plan.

US President  Donald Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform that an agreement had been "largely negotiated, subject to finalization" between the United States of America, the Islamic Republic of Iran, and various other countries.

"Final aspects and details of the deal are currently being discussed, and will be announced shortly," Trump said, adding that "the Strait of Hormuz will be opened."

The US president also mentioned that he had previously held talks with representatives from Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Jordan, and Bahrain, as well as a a separate telephone conversation with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Before that, Trump told CBS News that the two sides were "getting a lot closer" to finalizing a deal.

He refused to give specifics about the plan, but said that "every day it gets better and better."

In a separate interview with US news outlet Axios, Trump said the chance of an agreement was a "solid 50/50," while threatening to "blow them to kingdom come" if talks fail. 

Earlier in the day, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke of " slight progress" in negotiations, adding that "there might be some news a little later today," although it may come on Sunday or within "a couple of days."

Speaking during a visit to India, Rubio also refused to rule out a resumption of US attacks on Iran if negotiations fail.

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei, meanwhile, told state broadcaster IRIB that Tehran was in the final stages of drafting a framework for a deal, but said a final accord would take more time.

"Within a reasonable period of 30 to 60 days, the details of these points will be discussed and a final agreement will ultimately be concluded," Baqaei told IRIB.

He added that major gaps remain between both sides and that an end to the US blockade of Hormuz be part of the framework. The blockade has halted Iran's oil exports, the main source of income for the Islamic Republic.

title.en: In Iran, internet access becomes a luxury for the few
title.zh: 在伊朗，互联网接入成为少数人的奢侈品

summary.en: Despite the ongoing internet blockade in Iran, access to "Internet-Pro" is available to select groups for a fee. Access to information and communication is increasingly becoming a luxury.
summary.zh: 尽管伊朗持续进行互联网封锁，但少数特定群体可以付费使用“专业互联网”。信息和通讯的获取正日益成为一种奢侈品。

body.en:
Despite the ongoing internet blockade in Iran, access to "Internet-Pro" is available to select groups for a fee. Access to information and communication is increasingly becoming a luxury.

Iran's National Security Council recently approved a plan to grant certain groups paid internet access, albeit with a daily usage limit on foreign websites and international data traffic.

The internet in Iran has been shut down since the United States and Israel launched attacks on the country on February 28.

"Internet Pro" does not refer to a technical upgrade, but allows users standard internet access that bypasses the block.

According to journalist and internet researcher Solmaz Eikder, major platforms such as Instagram, X and YouTube — which have long been blocked in Iran — still cannot be used even by many "Internet Pro" users without a virtual private network (VPN).

Eikder has been living in exile in Europe for five years. She works for Filterbaan, also known as Filterwatch, an Iranian digital rights organization that monitors  internet censorship , digital repression and surveillance in Iran. The findings are frequently used by journalists, activists and researchers who study digital repression in Iran.

The current shutdown, which has now lasted for more than 80 days, is the  longest yet in Iran , but not the first of its kind.

For years, the Iranian security apparatus has used this method to disrupt communication between Iranians and to cut off the outside world. This most recently occurred during nationwide protests in January , which the regime brutally suppressed.

Millions of people are now once again cut off from the digital economy and communication.

According to government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani, "Internet Pro" is intended to "prevent disruptions to economic activity and ensure business communication in times of crisis."

The service is offered to certain professional groups, such as members of the Chamber of Commerce, startups, technology companies and retailers. They receive an initial package of 50 gigabytes of data, which costs the equivalent of about $11 (around €9.50).

"That's a lot of money in Iran," said Eikder. Since the war began, many households have been under growing economic pressure. Inflation has risen to over 50% and the value of the rial has plunged, leading to a sharp increase in prices for basic necessities.

Destroyed industrial facilities and massive production losses have hit the economy hard. Tens of thousands of jobs have been lost.

summary.en: The incident is China's deadliest mining accident since 2009, when a gas explosion at the Xinxing mine in Heilongjiang province killed 108 people.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As emergency rescuers undertook a major rescue operation after Saturday's mining accident that killed at least 82 people in northern China, a wounded survivor said he heard no sound but smelled sulphur when the explosion happened.

"I didn't hear any sound at all, but then a cloud of smoke appeared," miner Wang Yong said.

"When I smelled it, it was the smell of sulphur like when people set off firecrackers. When the smoke came down, I shouted for people to run," he said.

"After more than an hour, I came to on my own, and then I woke up the person next to me" and got out, he told Chinese broadcaster CCTV.

The blast at the Liushenyu shaft in Shanxi province was the country's worst mining disaster in nearly two decades, with 247 workers underground at the time, according to Chinese media.

Hundreds of rescuers have rushed to the site, with medical teams taking 128 people to the hospital as of Saturday evening (local time), loaded into ambulances and carried on stretchers. Two people still remain missing.

Agence France-Presse journalists saw police blocking the road leading to the mine late Saturday, allowing only authorised vehicles to enter.

Helmeted rescuers took turns descending into the shaft overnight to look for the two missing workers, state media reported.

"As long as there is hope, we will make every possible effort," one rescuer told Xinhua news agency.

Chinese authorities launched an investigation into the blast, the worst since 2009 when 108 people were killed in a mine explosion in northeastern Heilongjiang province.

Preliminary findings showed the company operating the mine had committed "serious illegal violations", authorities told a press conference.

"Those found responsible will be severely punished in accordance with laws and regulations," they added.

A person "responsible for" the company involved had been "placed under control in accordance with the law", Xinhua reported.

The State Council, China's cabinet, ordered nationwide "tough crackdowns on illegal and unlawful activities", including the falsification of safety data, unclear headcounts of underground workers and illegal contracting.

Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, is the centre of the country's coal-mining industry.

Mine safety in China has improved in recent decades, but accidents still occur in an industry where safety protocols are often lax and regulations are vague.

In 2023, a collapse at an open-pit coal mine in the northern Inner Mongolia region killed 53 people.

China is the world's top consumer of coal and the largest greenhouse gas emitter, despite installing renewable energy capacity at record speed.

body.zh: 周六，中国北方发生了导致至少 82 人死亡的矿难，紧急救援人员在开展重大救援行动时，一名受伤的幸存者表示，爆炸发生时他没有听到任何声音，但闻到了硫磺的味道。 “我根本没有听到任何声音，但随后出现了一团烟雾。”矿工王勇说。 “当我闻到的时候，那是硫磺的味道，就像人们放鞭炮时一样。当烟雾降下时，我大声喊叫人们快跑，”他说。 他告诉中国中央电视台，“一个多小时后，我自己醒了过来，然后我叫醒了旁边的人”，然后下了车。 据中国媒体报道，山西省六神峪竖井爆炸是该国近二十年来最严重的矿难，当时井下有 247 名工人。 截至周六晚间（当地时间），数百名救援人员已赶赴现场，医疗队已将 128 人送往医院，并装上救护车并用担架抬上。目前仍有两人失踪。 法新社记者周六晚看到警察封锁了通往矿井的道路，只允许经过授权的车辆进入。 据官方媒体报道，戴着头盔的救援人员连夜轮流进入竖井寻找两名失踪的工人。 “只要有希望，我们就会尽一切努力，”一名救援人员告诉新华社。 中国当局对这起爆炸展开调查，这是自2009年黑龙江省东北部矿井爆炸造成108人死亡以来最严重的一次。 当局在新闻发布会上表示，初步调查结果显示，该矿运营公司存在“严重违法行为”。 他们补充说：“对相关责任人，将依法依规予以严厉处罚。” 据新华社报道，涉事公司一名“负责人”已被“依法控制”。 中国国务院下令在全国范围内“严厉打击违法违规行为”，包括伪造安全数据、井下工人人数不明和非法承包等。 山西是中国较贫困的省份之一，也是全国煤炭开采业的中心。 近几十年来，中国的矿山安全有所改善，但安全规程往往松懈、法规模糊的行业中事故仍然时有发生。 2023年，内蒙古北部地区一座露天煤矿发生塌方，造成53人死亡。 尽管中国以创纪录的速度安装可再生能源产能，但它仍然是世界上最大的煤炭消费国和最大的温室气体排放国。 在中国寂静的沁源县，煤矿工人有时会在张的烤串店吃饭，尤其是在发薪日，事故已经发生……

title.en: East Africa wants to curb imports of used clothes. But it's not easy
title.zh: 东非希望限制旧衣服的进口。但这并不容易

summary.en: Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania are major importers of used garments from the West and China.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Not even heavy rain can keep shoppers away from Gikomba, a lively Kenyan market that stands as the largest open-air trading hub in East Africa.

Sections of the site were waterlogged on the day the BBC visited, yet shoppers, some wearing rubber boots, still inched their way through the congested pathways, hunting for Gikomba's speciality - second-hand clothing.

The trade in garments imported from the US, Europe and China poses a perennial problem for the East African Community (EAC), a regional bloc of which Kenya is a member. How can the region build a thriving fashion industry when it is saturated with cheap cast-offs?

"We're competing with second-hand clothing, but we can't compete on price," Zia Bett, founder of Kenyan womenswear brand Zia Africa, tells the BBC.

Elizabeth Paul, who owns Kuya Creations in Tanzania's main city of Dar es Salaam, agrees: "In my shop, the minimum price of a dress is 50,000 Tanzanian shillings (£14.50; $19.20). People tell me: 'For 50,000 I can get 10 second-hand dresses, so let me buy those.'"

A decade ago, the EAC decried the influx of second-hand clothing and was primed to impose a ban across its member states. After some strong-arming from the US, the proposal fell apart but now the debate has resurfaced.

Uganda, a country whose president once criticised second-hand clothing as coming from white "dead people", has introduced an additional 30% tax on imports in an effort to boost the local garment industry and protect the environment.

Days later, the treasury in neighbouring Kenya attempted to change the way it taxed used clothing, saying its proposed system would simplify things for importers. But following a backlash from Kenyans worried that this would lead to price rises, the proposal was swiftly dropped from the Finance Bill.

In a bid to support homegrown clothing manufacturers, Kenya already applies a 30% customs duty to imports of used clothing - 5% more than it costs to ship in new clothes.

According to trade data platform the Observatory of Economic Complexity (OEC), Kenya is currently Africa's leading importer of second-hand clothing or "mitumba" as they are known in Swahili.

The mitumba-loving nation received almost 180,000 tonnes of used clothing in 2022 - a 76% increase on the amount imported in 2013, UN trade data shows.

In neighbouring Uganda, second-hand clothes are the most sought-after garments, followed by imported new clothing and, lastly, locally manufactured clothing, the government-funded Economic Policy Research Centre found in 2024.

The new 30% environmental levy on used clothing comes on top of an existing 35% import duty and 18% VAT.

title.en: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan, and Australia, known as the Quad, must resolve past disagreements to maintain their alliance's effectiveness in countering China and boosting Indo-Pacific security.

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the United States , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days startng Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

Writing in the Foreign Policy magazine, Derek Grossman, a professor at the University of Southern California, cautioned that should Trump decline to take part in the next leaders' meeting, likely to...
body.zh: 如果该联盟要继续成为对抗中国的有效手段，美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚（统称为“四方”）的外交部长就需要将过去的分歧抛在脑后。 来自美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚这四个国家的外交部长将于周日开始在新德里举行为期三天的会议，讨论印太安全、能源供应和新兴技术。 这次会议召开之际，中国正在继续测试该地区的地缘政治和安全边界。 但另一个未列入议程的问题在这次会议上显得尤为突出：如何在日益具有挑战性的地缘政治格局和日益自信的中国中保持联盟的活力和相关性。 四方联盟将四个国家团结起来，寻求自由开放的印度太平洋地区 (FOIP)，自 2024 年时任总统乔·拜登在特拉华州威尔明顿接待各国领导人以来，该组织就没有举行过国家领导人会议。 印度原定于 2025 年下半年主办下一次年度会议，但由于印度与唐纳德·特朗普总统新政府之间的紧张关系，这一目标从未实现。 特朗普对印度输美产品征收关税和惩罚性关税，导致与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的关系紧张。这位美国总统去年五月声称已通过调解解决了印度和巴基斯坦之间的边境冲突，这进一步激怒了新德里。美国总统还批评印度购买俄罗斯军事装备。 一年后，率领美国代表团访问印度的国务卿马可·卢比奥肩负着平息外交争端的任务。由于特朗普的注意力显然集中在中东战争以及可能的古巴战争上，卢比奥的任务可能是一项具有挑战性的任务。 天普大学东京校区国际关系学教授詹姆斯·布朗表示：“美国、日本和澳大利亚已经达成了重要且有效的三边安全安排，但四方机制的全部目的是让印度成为另一个大国，以赋予其更大的影响力和影响力。” 他告诉德国之声：“不幸的是，本届美国政府似乎没有认识到这一点，也没有重视印度作为盟友的存在，这严重疏远了莫迪。” 日本和澳大利亚一直在努力保持四方联盟的完整和运作，布朗表示，四方联盟实际上可能会受益于卢比奥而不是特朗普在印度代表美国。 南加州大学教授德里克·格罗斯曼在《外交政策》杂志上撰文警告说，如果特朗普拒绝参加下一次领导人会议，可能会……

reflection.en: The call for the Quad nations to set aside past differences for a common goal reminds us of the ongoing effort required to maintain peace and cooperation. Even among allies, disagreements can arise, and a commitment to living at peace is essential for collective strength and stability.
reflection.zh: 呼吁“四方安全对话”国家为共同目标搁置过去的分歧，提醒我们维持和平与合作需要持续的努力。即使在盟友之间，分歧也可能出现，而致力于和平共处对于集体的力量和稳定至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: China: Dozens dead in coal mine blast — state media
title.zh: 中国：国家媒体称煤矿爆炸导致数十人死亡

summary.en: An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has resulted in the deaths of at least 82 people, with some individuals still missing. President Xi Jinping has called for comprehensive efforts to search for and rescue those unaccounted for.
summary.zh: 中国北方一座煤矿发生爆炸，造成至少82人死亡，仍有部分人员失踪。国家主席习近平已要求“全力以赴”搜寻和营救失踪人员。

body.en:
An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has killed at least 82 people, with some still unaccounted for, state media say. President Xi Jinping has demanded an "all-out" effort to search for and rescue those missing.

A gas explosion at a coal mine in northern China has killed at least 82 people, authorities reported Saturday, revising an earlier higher death toll.

The blast took place at 7:29 pm (1129 GMT/UTC) on Friday at the Liushenyu coal mine in Qinyuan county in Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, with 247 ⁠workers ​on duty ​underground, Xinhua said.

Local officials said the explosion is being investigated and noted that the mine operator had committed “serious violations” of the law, though they did not provide details about the specific breaches.

Earlier, state news outlet Xinhua said that levels of carbon monoxide had "exceeded limits" at the mine. Some of those trapped underground were in "critical condition," it said.

Chinese President Xi Jinping urged authorities to "spare no ‌effort" in treating the injured and conducting ‌search ​and rescue operations, according to Xinhua.

Xi also ordered a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and strict ​accountability in accordance with the law.

He stressed that "all regions and departments must draw lessons from this accident, remain constantly vigilant regarding workplace safety ... and resolutely prevent and curb the occurrence of major and catastrophic accidents."

In recent decades, mine safety in China has improved, but accidents are still frequent in an industry where safety protocols are often lax.

Don't let the algorithm hide the news. If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google by clicking here and hitting the "star" or "preferred" button , so you'll always see our verified news first.
body.zh: 官方媒体称，中国北方一座煤矿发生爆炸，已造成至少 82 人死亡，其中一些人仍下落不明。习近平主席要求“全力以赴”搜寻和营救失踪人员。 据官方媒体周六报道，中国北方一处煤矿瓦斯爆炸已造成至少 82 人死亡。 据官方通讯社新华社报道，救援人员仍在“密集”搜寻九名下落不明的人。 新华社称，爆炸发生在周五晚上 7 点 29 分（格林尼治标准时间/世界标准时间 1129 点），发生在中国较贫困的省份之一山西省沁源县的六神峪煤矿，当时有 247 名工人在井下执勤。 新华社报道说，到周六早些时候，大多数人已被安全地带到地面。 早些时候，新华社称该矿的一氧化碳含量“超出了限制”。报告称，一些被困地下的人“情况危急”。 据新华社报道，中国国家主席习近平敦促当局“不遗余力”救治伤者并开展搜救行动。 习近平还责令彻查事故原因，依法严肃问责。 他强调，“各地区、各部门要深刻汲取这次事故的教训，时刻保持安全生产意识……坚决预防和遏制重特大事故发生。” 近几十年来，中国的矿山安全有所改善，但安全规程往往不严的行业事故仍然频发。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in the coal mine explosion leaves many families brokenhearted and crushed in spirit. In such moments of profound grief and uncertainty, we are reminded that 雅伟 is near to those who suffer. May comfort and strength be found by all affected, especially those awaiting news of their loved ones.
reflection.zh: 煤矿爆炸造成的生命悲剧性逝去，让许多家庭心碎神伤。在这样深切的悲痛和不确定时刻，我们被提醒雅伟亲近伤心的人。愿所有受影响的人，特别是那些等待亲人消息的人，都能找到安慰和力量。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: US arms sales to Taiwan on ‘pause’ due to Iran war, says acting navy chief
title.zh: 美国代理海军部长称，对台湾的军售因伊朗战争而“暂停”

summary.en: Washington's acting navy secretary stated that US arms sales to Taiwan have been temporarily halted. This pause is to ensure sufficient munitions are available for ongoing US military operations in Iran, adding to recent doubts about sustained US support for Taipei.
summary.zh: 华盛顿代理海军部长表示，美国对台湾的军售已暂停。此举是为了确保美国军方有足够的弹药用于其在伊朗的军事行动，这进一步加剧了近期对美国能否持续支持台北的疑虑。

body.en: Hung Cao’s comments are latest blow to Taipei after Donald Trump recently cast doubt over US’s enduring support US arms sales to Taiwan have been “paused” to ensure the US military has enough munitions for its Iran operations, according to Washington’s acting navy secretary, in the latest blow to Taipei after a series of comments by Donald Trump. When asked at a congressional hearing on Thursday about a $14bn (£10.4bn) weapons package awaiting Trump’s signoff for months, Hung Cao said: “Right now we’re doing a pause in order to make sure we have the munitions we need for Epic Fury [the Iran war] – which we have plenty.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 华盛顿代理海军部长表示，唐纳德·特朗普最近对美国的持久支持表示怀疑，美国已“暂停”对台军售，以确保美军有足够的弹药用于其伊朗行动，曹洪的言论是对台北的最新打击。这是唐纳德·特朗普发表一系列言论后对台北的最新打击。在周四的国会听证会上，当被问及等待特朗普签署数月之久的价值 140 亿美元（104 亿英镑）的武器计划时，曹洪表示：“现在我们正在暂停，以确保我们拥有史诗般的愤怒（伊朗战争）所需的弹药——我们有足够的弹药。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: News of arms sales being paused due to another conflict highlights the constant demand for military resources in a world marked by tension. The prophet Isaiah envisioned a future where nations would transform instruments of war into tools for peace, no longer training for battle. This vision calls us to hope for a day when global resources are dedicated to...
reflection.zh: 军售因另一场冲突而暂停的消息，凸显了在一个充满紧张的世界中对军事资源的持续需求。先知以赛亚曾预见一个未来，各国将把战争工具转化为和平工具，不再为战争训练。这一愿景呼唤我们盼望有一天，全球资源将致力于建设生命，而非备战。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heavy rain triggers flooding and landslides in parts of China
title.zh: 中国部分地区持续强降雨引发洪灾和山体滑坡

summary.en: Heavy, prolonged rainfall in southern and central China has caused widespread flooding and landslides, leading to the deaths of twelve people. The severe weather has also resulted in significant travel disruption, electricity outages, and evacuations across affected areas.
summary.zh: 中国南方和中部地区持续强降雨引发大范围洪水和山体滑坡，已造成十二人死亡。恶劣天气还导致受灾地区交通中断、电力供应中断，并进行了人员疏散。

body.en: Twelve dead as southern and central areas also suffer travel disruption, electricity outages and evacuations Heavy, prolonged rainfall in southern and central China has resulted in weather warnings for flash flooding, landslides and waterlogging. The slow-moving band of rainfall spanned 620 miles (1,000km) and travelled eastwards across the regions on Tuesday. It was formed from the convergence of multiple bands of rain originating from the Bay of Bengal, South China Sea and Pacific Ocean. Given the accompanying low wind speeds, high daily and hourly rainfall totals have been recorded, with as much as 75mm locally in Hunan, 85mm in Anhui in a 24-hour period, and 95mm on the island of Hainan. Twelve people have died because of the flooding and hundreds of residents have been evacuated by emergency services. There were major travel disruptions, electricity outages, as well as school and business closures. Social media posts showed submerged cars and people fishing along flooded streets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 南部和中部地区也遭遇出行中断、停电和疏散，造成 12 人死亡 中国南部和中部地区持续强降雨，引发山洪、山体滑坡和内涝天气警报。周二，降雨带横跨 1,000 公里（620 英里），并稳步向东移动穿过该地区。这是一条缓慢移动的雨带，由来自孟加拉湾、南中国海和太平洋的多个雨带汇聚而成。加上风速较低，日、小时降雨总量较高，湖南局部24小时降雨量高达75毫米，安徽24小时降雨量高达85毫米，海南岛24小时降雨量高达95毫米。洪水已造成 12 人死亡，数百名居民已被紧急服务部门疏散。出现了严重的旅行中断、停电以及学校和企业关闭的情况。沿着被洪水淹没的街道，社交媒体帖子显示汽车被淹没，人们在钓鱼。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of devastating floods and landslides, communities experience immense loss and disruption. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that even when the earth gives way, God remains our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. This truth offers a steady anchor for those navigating the chaos and rebuilding their lives.
reflection.zh: 面对毁灭性的洪水和山体滑坡，社区遭受了巨大的损失和破坏。诗篇46:1提醒我们，即使大地动摇，雅伟仍是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。这个真理为那些在混乱中挣扎并重建生活的人们提供了稳固的锚。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 中国新监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声披露了中国高科技警务的详细信息。该系统利用滑雪场的面部识别和火车座位等技术，可以追踪任何人并建立“综合档案”，让外国人无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in the Chinese capital Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cell phone numbers, visa details, and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watchlist.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners. It accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations, and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."

body.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。从滑雪场面部识别到火车座位，该系统可以跟踪任何人并编制“整体档案”。 当一位化名 NetAskari 的网络安全研究人员最近点击一个不安全的中文网络仪表板上标有“查询记者档案”的选项卡时，他预计会看到一堆自动生成的模拟数据。 取而代之的是，熟悉的面孔出现在屏幕上。这是 2021 年左右驻扎在中国首都北京的几乎所有外国记者的综合数据库，包括在出入境管理局拍摄的官方护照照片、私人手机号码、签证详细信息和出生日期。他还发现自己的确切个人信息隐藏在中国警方的监视名单上。 “这比令人震惊更有趣，”内特阿斯卡里告诉德国之声。 “当你在中国担任记者时，你基本上会认为你总是在他们的监视范围内。但令我惊讶的是访问这个高度敏感的系统是多么容易。” NetAskari 偶然发现的是现代中国新兴的“全息轮廓”系统的一部分。 他无意中访问了为主办 2022 年冬季奥运会的河北省张家口市公安局设计的远程跟踪系统演示版本。 虽然它只是一个测试面板，但它填充了真实的数据集，清楚地概述了中国国家监控机器的轨迹，该机器正在从简单的街道摄像头网络迅速演变为数据融合的、24/7、预测性的社会控制庞然大物。 多年来，中国运营着世界上最广泛的闭路电视网络。一项名为“雪亮”（明亮的眼睛）项目的大规模倡议旨在合并这些分布在全国各地的监视孤岛。 但张家口警方仪表板上的数据显示了当局可以追踪个人的详细信息。 该系统不再仅仅依赖街角的警察摄像头。它准确记录目标从北京或上海到达时所占用的具体火车车厢和座位号。 它甚至将当地滑雪场的面部识别检票口拍摄的照片直接同步到其跟踪机制中。研究人员最近在张家口滑雪的熟人的动作被精确标记，并在系统中绘制出详细的轨迹。 研究人员指出：“这个想法只是实时处理来自尽可能多的传感器的尽可能多的数据。” 该系统记录日常行为，例如汽油消耗、常规购物地点以及个人是否经常访问“请愿区”。 这项大规模的数据融合工作试图……

reflection.en: The news of pervasive surveillance systems highlights the immense power states can wield over individuals. When such power is unchecked, it can feel like living under constant scrutiny, eroding personal freedom and privacy. This reminds us of the biblical warning about rulers who oppress their people, creating an environment of fear rather than security.
reflection.zh: 普遍存在的监控系统新闻突显了国家对个人可能施加的巨大权力。当这种权力不受制约时，人们可能会感到生活在持续的审视之下，个人自由和隐私受到侵蚀。这提醒我们圣经中关于压迫人民、制造恐惧而非安全的统治者的警告。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: 'My dear friend': Putin and Xi praise partnership during talks in Beijing
title.zh: “我的挚友”：普京和习近平在北京会谈中赞扬伙伴关系

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping praised their partnership during talks in Beijing. China continues to be a significant and loyal economic partner to Russia, despite international economic and financial sanctions imposed on Russia by other countries.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统普京和中国国家主席习近平在北京会谈期间赞扬了两国伙伴关系。尽管其他国家对俄罗斯实施了经济和金融制裁，中国仍然是俄罗斯重要而忠诚的经济伙伴。

body.en:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has lauded his close ties with Chinese leader Xi Jinping, saying the nations are partners in trade and international affairs during bilateral talks in Beijing.

Xi welcomed Putin with a ceremony at the Great Hall of the People only days after meeting United States President Donald Trump.

The quick succession of Trump's and Putin's visits highlighted China's growing role as an international superpower, experts say.

Putin greeted Xi warmly as they met for the bilateral talks, describing the Chinese president as a "dear friend".

"We are truly delighted to see you. We keep in constant touch, both personally and through our aides in the government," he said.

Xi also stressed the "political mutual trust and strategic co-operation" between the countries, according to Chinese state media.

The two leaders have praised each other profusely in the past — Xi once describing Putin as his "best and most intimate friend".

Xi and Putin were set to focus on energy and security as well as their overall ties.

Chinese state media reported both parties agreed to extend a friendship treaty first signed in 2001.

China became Russia's top trading partner after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

China has said it is neutral in the conflict, maintaining trade ties with Russia despite economic and financial sanctions against Russia by the US and Europe.

China is the top customer for Russian oil and gas supplies, and Russia expects the war in Iran to increase the demand.

Her fluffy pink-and-yellow cardigan stands out in the crowd, where each player is fixated on the board in front of them.

Like many times before, the nine-year-old is about to win a game of chess against a man more than twice her age.

"So, I like more girl chess players, and when I see people around me that are girls, I feel happy and I want to win," Liu tells SBS News.

While chess has found a new audience through pop culture and online platforms, many female players say the competitive world still feels overwhelmingly male, prompting questions around why so few girls continue playing into adulthood.

Popular streaming content, such as drama series The Queen's Gambit and a recent documentary about Hungarian chess champion Judit Polgár, has again put a spotlight on the experiences of women in the game.

Chess.com, the world's largest online chess platform, says it has surpassed 250 million members worldwide, with nearly 15 million new accounts created in the first three months of 2026 alone.
